findings.title: Demand certificate metadata names Nutrition rather than its Fitness basis
findings.description: The full path correctly reconstructs D.ref_s34_id=F, but the DEMAND_FEATURE validity dependency copies demand_basis[2] (S37.ref_s34_id=N) into its optional proposal_id attribute. The committed full-suite witness records Demand af15a614-031a-503c-bb0b-a02f4719f4ac with ref_s34_id=66c7e7d1-cc21-5d89-a295-cd1c530e75a1, while both issuance certificates label proposal_id=3c3b42d0-a049-5a44-b504-b6fb870944a7, the Nutrition proposal. This is misleading audit metadata. The authoritative Demand identity/revision, F/D/N reconstruction, ordered per-action bindings, issuance references and finite validity guards remain correct, so it is not an execution-authority blocker.
findings.suggested_change: In a separately reviewed follow-up, derive this attribute from demand_basis[3] (the physical D.ref_s34_id) for the full profile, preserving the legacy branch, and assert it against the persisted Demand basis.
